responsibility: Applies the little-endian variant defaults for rs6000 SysV4 targets. It changes the target default ISA flags and assembler default endianness to little-endian, adjusts multilib defaults accordingly, and marks little-endian PowerPC64 Linux as defaulting to the ELFv2 ABI, making it the small policy header that flips the generic SysV4 configuration into LE mode.
